title: WorkerResult
description: Structured result an implementation worker returns via --json-schema. These are the worker's CLAIMS. The dispatcher records them separately from its own observations and treats nothing here as verified.

status.description: completed = you finished the work. blocked = you could not proceed and have reported why. failed = you attempted the work and it did not succeed. Completion is not approval.

summary.description: What you actually did, in plain terms. No marketing.

changes.description: Every file you changed. Must match the real diff.

acceptance_criteria.description: One entry per criterion you were given. Do not redefine, merge, or invent criteria.

evidence.description: Concrete evidence: a test name, a command and its output, a file and line. Not an assertion that it works.

tests.description: Test commands you actually ran. The dispatcher may re-run trusted commands independently and compare.

risks.description: Things that could break, regressions you suspect, assumptions you had to make.

blockers.description: Anything that stopped you. Report conflicts rather than inventing scope to resolve them.

needs_review.description: Always true in practice: Sol reviews everything. Completion is evidence, never approval.
